Irene (CS): Flagging a short incident: a subset of new onboarding tenants reported missing embeddings in search and intermittent 5xxs between 11:0311:11 UTC. Customers are asking for status and we should offer make-good credits + enablement sessions. Can Eng/SRE confirm current state? :eyes:
Devon (Eng): Quick triage: a schema mismatch in the batcher introduced during a config tweak caused some chunk headers to be rejected by the validator, which then triggered retries and transient overload. We've paused the batcher and started targeted replays for affected job-ids. No evidence of data leakage.
Hyejin (SRE): Cluster stabilized after throttling retries and isolating the batcher node pool. Replay progress ~45%. We're watching queue depth and error rate; dashboard: https://internal.metrics/embeds/462345. ETA for full catch-up ~1.5-3h depending on peak.
Carlos (AM): I'll draft tailored notes for enterprise trials and next-90d renewals. Proposed message: 'We're mitigating an ingestion regression that affected a small set of accounts. Engineering has applied a mitigation and is replaying affected data. We expect full restoration shortly. No customer data exposure. We're offering make-good credits and dedicated enablement sessions. A formal RCA will follow.' Any changes?
Irene (CS): Add a request for customers to share failing job ids or sample payloads so we can validate replays. Offer: $125 credit or 15% of that billing cycle (min $75), plus a 30-min enablement. Also schedule two office hours slots this week.
Devon (Eng): Agree. Please include a quick verification customers can run once we say recovered: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"healthcheck"}' | jq '.status'``` expecting "ok" and subsequent search hit.
PingBot: Replay update: job-ids [bf-4623-01, bf-4623-03, bf-4623-07] progress=45% ETA=02:10:00
Irene (CS): Action items: 1) Carlos send the external comm to impacted list and include retry guidance + self-check 2) CS collect job ids/payloads in tracker https://docs.internal/cs/inc-462345-feedback 3) Eng/SRE draft RCA and share within 72h 4) Schedule enablement office hours and invite impacted tenants.
Carlos (AM): Sending now to top 10 impacted tenants and flagging renewal-risk bucket. I'll paste replies here.
Hyejin (SRE): Replay at 76% and no new validator failures. Will post final confirmation when backfills complete.
Irene (CS): Thanks everyone. Please escalate any customers who indicate renewal concerns or inability to validate after recovery. I'll consolidate feedback and coordinate follow-ups. :pray:
